subject: Revise forecast tiers — commit decision playbook & quick training
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Revise forecast tiers — commit decision playbook & quick training

Hi team,

After the finance/ops sync last week we agreed to tighten the definitions for Commit / Best Case / Pipeline to reduce over-commit and improve forecast signal. I attached a concise decision playbook (commit-decision-matrix-v2.pdf) and a 6-slide quick deck that you can drop into any account update (forecast-playbook-quick-deck.pptx).

High level changes (preview):
- Commit: Active exec alignment + signed MOA/PO or explicit legal/finance signoff.
- Best Case: High probability with strong technical/exec alignment and procurement in active review, but no signed financial instrument.
- Pipeline: All other qualified opportunities without confirmed procurement steps.

Ask: please update all open deals you own in HubSpot to these categories by EOD Friday (2027-08-06). For any borderline deals, use the decision matrix attached and add a one-line rationale in the deal notes (example: "Exec call + SOW under review; Best Case").

Training: I'm scheduling a rapid 20-minute refresher for AE/CSD owners to walk the matrix and show a 3-step decision flow. Please RSVP for a slot that works for you: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=commit-health-20m

If you have a deal where this change would move ARR into Commit and you need an exception (credits, early recognition, or SLA tagging), flag it to me + finance (laura_bennett) and we'll review on a case-by-case basis.

Thanks — I know this is a short turnaround, but small, consistent tagging wins us better predictability for Q3 planning.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Revise forecast tiers — commit decision playbook & quick training

Marissa — good question. Short rule to follow (pulled from the attached matrix):

- If signature is scheduled but unsigned AND there is no finance PO issued yet -> Best Case.
- Move to Commit only when we have either: (A) executed PO/SOW or (B) a written, timestamped procurement approval email from the buyer's finance/procurement team that references the contract value.

Edge cases:
- Verbal commitments + exec approval but no procurement timestamp -> Best Case.
- If the customer sends a DocuSign envelope (tracking id) and legal confirms it was sent on X date -> treat as Best Case until executed.

Operational steps I'm asking for this week:
1) AEs add one-sentence rationale to deal notes for any change (example: "PO issued 2027-08-04; Commit").
2) Use the decision matrix PDF to justify moves during the daily forecast call (two-line summary).
3) If you want an exception for recognition or credits, tag me and Laura in the deal so we can triage.

I also created two 20-minute slots (Wednesday 08/04 at 10:00AM and Thursday 08/05 at 3:00PM PT). RSVP link in the calendar invite above. I'll run a 10-minute walkthrough and leave 10 minutes for deal Q&A.

Attachments referenced: commit-decision-matrix-v2.pdf (one page) and forecast-playbook-quick-deck.pptx (6 slides).

—Karthik
